scorecard: beat grid + BPM (Normal mode, BALib v1)
command: cargo run --release -p mb-analysis --example beat_score  (--verbose lists every track; --dump prints beats)
test: cargo test --release -p mb-analysis --test oracle beats_match_rekordbox  (probes; MB_ORACLE_FULL=1 for all 161)
fixture: oracle-a (Normal mode, BPM range 70-180, high precision off, phrase analysis on)
tracks_note: the 161 oracle-a tracks with a PQT2 (analysed by rekordbox itself); the 8 shipped sampler loops carry preset grids

targets.beats_within_1ms: >= 99.5%: not met (97.5%); every miss is the phrase pass's whole-grid shift
targets.downbeat: >= 99%: not met (151/161 = 93.8%); every miss is the phrase pass's renumbering

phrase_pass_moved.cause: CBeatAnalyzeThread::analyze moves the grid to SongStructureAnalyze's first downbeat (spec § 8); not ported
phrase_pass_moved.invariant: BPM, beat count, spacing, per-beat tempo and PQT2 µs remainders still match on all 21

unmoved_copies_identical: the 5 click_128_offset1234 copies without the phrase shift (mp3 x3, m4a aac, one wav) equal rekordbox's grid exactly, starting at 296/320/343 ms
oracle_b: not applicable: high precision on (BALib v2 + madmom), see spec § 9
runtime: about 0.9 s CPU per track including decode (161 tracks in 12 s on 12 threads)
